title: No Fish
description: This mod removes all fish from Minecraft, so oceans, rivers, and lakes no longer have any fish mobs. Fishing changes completely, and you can’t collect fish items or use them for food or crafting.
body: No Fish deletes every fish-related mob and item in the game, including cod, salmon, pufferfish, and tropical fish. None of them spawn in the water anymore, and fishing won’t give you fish drops. You also can’t use fish for cooking, trading, taming cats, or crafting water-breathing potions. Oceans feel emptier, underwater exploring changes, and early-game food or fishing strategies become useless. It turns aquatic gameplay into a much more quiet and challenging experience.
